'''Overhang''' was a seedy industrial zone in [[Nexus City]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Entralla/Legends|Entralla]].

==History==
Overhang was an industrial center located on the outskirts of [[Nexus City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Entralla/Legends|Entralla]]. Located near the planet's main [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], the area was home to many native Entrallans who were employed by the massive transit center or industrial corporations. Because of the Overhang's dense infrastructure, [[Star/Legends|sunlight]] rarely penetrated down to ground level.<ref name="J4" />
